joined.title: Velocity, not spend, drove reach
joined.subtitle: Media spend (SAP) x campaign reach (Salesforce) x assets shipped (Monday) — indexed, Sep = 100

annotation.label: Output surges, reach lags two months

insight.headline: Reach grew 80% on just +7% media spend — 4x content output did the work
insight.detail: Overlaying SAP spend actuals on the Monday publishing calendar and Salesforce reach shows the January Higgsfield output surge pulling reach up with a two-month lag, while paid spend stayed essentially flat. SAP only sees a flat budget, Monday only sees volume, and Salesforce only sees a reach curve — none alone can prove velocity, not media dollars, is the growth engine.
insight.action: Hold FY27 media budget flat and reinvest the headroom in overnight Higgsfield batch capacity.
